name: Zhalfir
description: Zhalfir is Teferi's homeland, a plane ruled by Queen Wezna that Teferi phased out of Dominaria and sent into a void out of time.

summary.text: Zhalfir is Teferi's homeland, a plane ruled by Queen Wezna that Teferi phased out of Dominaria and sent into a void out of time.

bio.text: Teferi created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
Teferi went to the beach to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline, questioned whether hiding it was self-serving, and told Kwende it was not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
He resolved to search for a way to return Zhalfir, and later confided that he had lost the continent through a similar spell.
Kaervek was a prisoner of Zhalfir who escaped his amber prison.
After the war, Nissa tried to feel Zhalfir and found it did not answer, but when she called to it in a chorus the plane forgave her.

status.text: As of the latest story Zhalfir is the plane where the survivors live, and it has forgiven Nissa after first not answering her.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

timeline.summary: Teferi, living quietly as a scholar, goes to the beach at dawn to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline.
timeline.quote: Teferi walked out to the beach before dawn, to where he could see Zhalfir reflected in the sunrise.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

timeline.summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
timeline.quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Kwende Zhalfir is not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir is not destroyed!

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

timeline.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
timeline.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
timeline.quote: I think our time is up,

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
timeline.quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

timeline.summary: Teferi sleeps and dreams of Kroog, Argoth, and the Phyrexian stabbing him, and of Subira no longer wandering.
timeline.quote: The cold pressure when the Phyrexian stabbed him.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses time magic on the path and sees the beach decline from joyful to fearful and then empty, realizing he is in Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: reached into time, pulling history from the dust

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.
timeline.quote: Nearly four hundred years later, he was back in Zhalfir.

timeline.summary: Teferi steps out in front of a caravan and is held at spearpoint by its guards.
timeline.quote: had Teferi surrounded and at spearpoint within the minute

timeline.summary: Teferi lies to the guard leader that he was attacked by bandits.
timeline.quote: I was attacked by bandits

timeline.summary: Eshe introduces herself and Teferi gives a false name.
timeline.quote: I am Eshe.

timeline.summary: Teferi reads Eshe's memory of the dead comrades, learning that the guards are themselves bandits who killed ten.
timeline.quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

timeline.summary: A frightened caravanner warns Teferi that the guards are bandits, and Eshe realizes who he is.
timeline.quote: She knew who he was.

timeline.summary: Eshe speaks of Zhalfir's generations of war and loss and accuses a snake among them.
timeline.quote: Every one of us here is linked in grief,

timeline.summary: Eshe names Teferi as the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering.
timeline.quote: Here is Teferi, the snake.

timeline.summary: Eshe thrusts her spear at Teferi's heart and he freezes time.
timeline.quote: She lifted her spear, coiled her strength, and thrust for his heart.

timeline.summary: In frozen time, Teferi tells the slowed Eshe about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
timeline.quote: I loved a caravanner once,

timeline.summary: Teferi vows to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.
timeline.quote: I will see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.

timeline.summary: Teferi demonstrates blue mana and resumes time, and Eshe tells him to go away.
timeline.quote: summoning up a fearsome blue light

timeline.summary: Teferi leaves the caravan alone, and Eshe departs in the opposite direction.
timeline.quote: Teferi went away, hurrying down the road, alone.

timeline.summary: Months later, Teferi works with villagers hauling a fishing net and speaks with Oyana, who calls him the father of Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: You are the father of Zhalfir.

timeline.summary: Teferi says no one can stop the Phyrexians, and Oyana withdraws.
timeline.quote: No one can stop them. Not even the brave.

timeline.summary: Jabari reveals another outsider has come to Zhalfir and asked for Teferi.
timeline.quote: You are not the only one from outside to come here.

timeline.summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Adia gives Teferi mended robes and confesses she fears that return to the world means war will truly begin.
timeline.quote: I'm not so sure that Zhalfir returning to the world is a good thing

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls freezing his daughter Niambi in time and then catching her, deciding to stand with Zhalfir rather than stop the fall.
timeline.quote: he had frozen her in time, arresting her mid-fall

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Adia that Zhalfir is not just war and cannot stop what is coming but can control what follows.
timeline.quote: We are not bound by fate,

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
timeline.quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

timeline.summary: Wrenn calls to Teferi, who vouches for her to the queen and asks how he can help.
timeline.quote: "She's a friend of mine."

timeline.summary: Wrenn asks Teferi to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
timeline.quote: "We need you on New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
timeline.quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Teferi say a farewell as thousands answer his call.
timeline.quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"

timeline.summary: Zhalfir's warriors cross the portal led by Teferi, ready for war after many years.
timeline.quote: It has been many years since they were called to war—but Zhalfir stands ready.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins celebrate with drums that Phyrexia is defeated while Teferi mourns at a grassy hill.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia lies broken and defeated beyond the reach of time.

timeline.summary: Teferi plants an acorn on a grassy hill as a tribute to Wrenn and speaks to the mound.
timeline.quote: He lays the acorn in the little clearing he has made, then fills it in.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
timeline.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

timeline.summary: Kaya shares news of the other planes, including that Liliana, Vivien and Tyvar are well and that Jace and Vraska are still missing.
timeline.quote: Still no sign of Jace, or Vraska

timeline.summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
timeline.quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

timeline.summary: Koth seeks advice from Elspeth about Melira's plan and whether Ajani and Nissa deserve mercy.
timeline.quote: "It's going to kill her, doing that," Koth says.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Koth that Melira chooses her end freely and urges him to make Zhalfir home, then flies him to the ward.
timeline.quote: "You will try to make this place home. It will welcome you, if you let it."

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.
timeline.quote: "Together, Venser," he says

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
timeline.quote: "She's gone."

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes and reunites with Chandra, giving the survivors hope.
timeline.quote: "I'm right here," Chandra says.

timeline.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

timeline.summary: Chandra helps Nissa melt her Phyrexian carapace and bury it, and reveals she will leave the next day to find Ajani.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Tomorrow, I'm leaving to find Ajani."

timeline.summary: Nissa asks what kind of love Chandra has for her and, hurt by her answer, tells her to go; Chandra leaves.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Then be clear—exactly what kind of love do you have for me?"

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to meditate beside the sprout of Wrenn but her connection to the Multiverse is smothered by the voices of those who touched her mind, and she collapses in pain.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She screams for real.

timeline.summary: A blue rift tears open and a lightning-veined beast bursts out, forcing Nissa to fight it alone and without her magic or leylines.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The beast is like nothing she has seen before

timeline.summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

timeline.summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: it sounds like Zendikar.

timeline.summary: The beast returns and ransacks the village; Nissa leads it away with roots.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Slowly, vine by vine, swing by swing, Nissa leads the creature out of the village.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives and fights the beast with fire, but her fireballs boil a baobab and make it grow colossal, forcing them into a pit.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Chandra pushes Nissa out of the way of its snapping jaws

timeline.summary: Trapped, Nissa confronts Chandra about her broken promise, and Chandra apologizes, saying she still wants to know her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "But I still want to know you."

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that her connections are changing her voice into something more powerful; Nissa calls to Zhalfir in a chorus and the plane forgives her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The plane answers.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the creature is a storm elemental from another plane and channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to heat it into steam and rain.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Chandra pours heat and energy into the creature.

timeline.summary: Floating in the flood, Chandra explains her love and promises to give Nissa room; they kiss.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Nissa pulls Chandra into a kiss.

timeline.summary: After celebrating, Nissa and Chandra step through the portal together, hoping to find Zendikar.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Hand in hand, Chandra and Nissa step through the portal into just one of infinite possibilities.

relations.note: Teferi's home continent, lost through a spell he cast.
relations.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.
I serve at the pleasure of the queen.

relations.note: he sent Zhalfir away into a void
relations.quote: She didn't lose anyone when I sent Zhalfir away.

relations.note: a prisoner of Zhalfir who escaped his amber prison

pages_say.description: A once-advanced nation that Teferi phased partly out of Dominaria to protect it from Phyrexians.
A nation partially removed from Dominaria by Teferi, whose ghostly coastline is visible from the beach.
The continent Teferi lost through a time spell.
A place where Teferi once mistook Jaya for a line cook.
Teferi's homeland, which he spirited away from space and time.
A plane that Teferi sent into a void out of time, still preparing for a Phyrexian war.
A plane hidden out of time, bright and peaceful, which Teferi's people called to war defend.
Teferi's homeland that swapped places with New Phyrexia and now hosts the Mirran survivors.
A plane that returns to the Multiverse, swapping places with New Phyrexia.
The plane where the survivors live and which at first does not answer Nissa.
